conversations.$comment: Played by LevelBase._run_conversation the first time she arrives.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Apo. There you are. I was waiting for you, I think.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Funny. I was never in this one. I do not know how I came to be standing in it.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Listen. The brush has what it has, and nothing on this mountain gives any back. Spend it like you mean it.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: There was a way across here. We came over it a minute ago. Now look at it.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: There. Back where it was. Nearly.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: The path is going thin. Like a word you had on your tongue a moment ago.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Up we go. Your lola would have done the same.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: That is the last of it. Keep climbing.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Careful, apo. Back to where we were.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Apo. Look. Those are ours. Those are -- I know that one. I know all of them.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Not that. Something that was in it.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: There is no more ink for that one.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: That one? Nobody needed that one. ... She painted it anyway, didn't she.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: The terraces. I carried your lola down those, once, in the rain. There -- I had lost that.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: We were married in that one. Apo. Your name is -- yes. Apo. I have it again.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: My bangka. I was going to tell you something about the sea. I remember now what it was.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Apo, I -- what was I. I was going to say. I am sorry. I had it a moment ago.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: No. Put it down, apo. The brush was never for that. Your lola knew.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: That is why she painted the places instead. The fiesta, the sea, the house. That is how she kept m

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: Your lola and I came up here once, for the -- the. What do you call it. With the dancing. Ha. Old age, apo.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: I had it a moment ago. The name of -- no. It will come back. It always comes back.

lines.speaker: lolo
lines.text: See the fold, apo? Right through her plaza. That was us. ... Did I say that already? I think I said that already.
